title: the mass switch of ObjectBeamGeometricallyExact becomes exu.special.beams.geometricallyExactLumpedMass
author: Claude-JG
description: exu.experimental.beamGeometricallyExactConsistentMass (RG4.8.4) stays as a switch, for tests with both mass matrices, but as a special setting: exu.special.beams.geometricallyExactLumpedMass, default False (the consistent mass); the experimental one goes (maintainer, 2026-09-30).
releaseNotes: The mass matrix of ObjectBeamGeometricallyExact is switched with exu.special.beams.geometricallyExactLumpedMass (default False: the element-consistent mass); exu.experimental.beamGeometricallyExactConsistentMass is gone.
